name: tcp-printer
description: Sends everything the BBC prints to a raw TCP printer port on the network, such as a JetDirect printer or a printer emulator.

parameters.label: Printer URL
parameters.description: Printer endpoint as [scheme://]host:port (e.g. url="socket://printer.local:9100"); alternative to host/port, cannot be combined with them

parameters.label: Printer host
parameters.description: Printer hostname or address (default localhost; alternative to url)

parameters.label: Printer port
parameters.description: Printer TCP port (default 9100, the JetDirect convention; alternative to url)

parameters.label: Buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: receiver queue depth in bytes; when it is full the BBC waits for /ACK

parameters.label: Reconnect interval (ms)
parameters.description: milliseconds between connection attempts while not connected; 0 makes one attempt and never retries
